why: B is Definition 9.2.16 read literally. It says the project's ∂Θ is a functor X → ℚ⁺ with (1) supp ⊆ ∂X and (2) the local formula at the points of supp(F), and that it is the only such functor. As its author predicted, B does not hold as we read it. (2) is vacuous for F = 0, while for Θ = 1 on [0, ∞) (isBranchedEpSubgroupoid_one) ∂Θ(0) = 1 (boundaryTheta_halfLine_one), so uniqueness fails (not_B). A records exactly this: isBoundaryCharacterized_zero and not_unique_isBoundaryCharacterized_halfLine. A also gives existence under Theorem 9.2.1's independence hind, and uniqueness in the corrected reading (eq_boundaryTheta: F = 0 off supp Θ, and the local formula at the points of supp Θ). So A ⇒ B is false (not_A_to_B), and B ⇒ A holds only ex falso. The author proposed a repair: (2) at the points of supp Θ, and F = 0 off supp Θ. A ⇒ BRepaired is proved for that repair with hind added as a hypothesis. Without hind, the existence half does not follow from A (as in V9_26). Universes at 0.
